collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager braids a friend's hair, weaving in thin strands of dyed fiber.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (subject) braids (friend)'s hair, weaving in thin strands of dyed fiber. The finished braids are admired by everyone at supper.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (subject) braids (friend)'s hair, weaving in thin strands of dyed fiber. They talk so much that the braid ends up much longer than planned.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (subject) braids (friend)'s hair, weaving in thin strands of dyed fiber. (friend) asks for the same style again tomorrow.

e4__fx.name: Ending 4
e4__fx.text: (subject) braids (friend)'s hair, weaving in thin strands of dyed fiber. A strand of red fiber comes loose and is tucked back in with a laugh.

e4__text.name: Ending 4
